Name: Corporate Takeover (Jojamart Prices)
Author: jerrylee22
Description:
Corporate Takeover:

Jojamart has entered Stardew Valley with a competitive edge over the local townsfolk.

Jojamart can fullfill (almost) all of your retail transaction requirements!

No longer do you have to go to Pierre's to buy seeds, fertilizer, or bouquets!
No longer does Jojamart charge a premium on products!
No longer do you have to go to the Adventure's Guild to sell equipment or Willy's to sell fresh fish!
No longer do you have to witness a troubled marriage to buy lumber!
(Almost) everything can be sold directly at the counter!
Decorate your farm with Joja branded furniture and decor from day one!

Includes (but not limited to):

Jojamart sells everything found at Pierre's.
Jojamart sells for normal prices (regardless of membership).
Jojamart also buys everything all other shops do (except certain artifacts/trinkets).
Jojamart sells certain things that other shops do (only Robin's wood/stone for now).
Jojamart Catalogue available for 75g.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42212]JojaMart Sells It Too[/url] adds a lot more than this mod (and has SVE compatability), but Corporate Takeover is more similar to the base shop, with the added benefit of universal salability and purchasing resources. Everything is available in the standard checkout, too.

(To be fair, I wouldn't have even made this is the first place, but I started my Joja Route playthrough in January and waited to publish this. I honestly would prefer to modify their's and combine them, but I couldn't publish it).

NOTE (COMPATABILITY):

[b]NOT COMPATABILE WITH ANY MOD THAT CHANGES THE JOJAMART SHOP. THIS IS AN OVERWRITE MOD AND WILL CAUSE ERRORS.[/b]

Downloads.Description:
Ensure dependencies are downloaded.
Unzip and copy [CP] Corporate Takeover (Jojamart Prices) to Mods folder.
